en: Talks to Anthropic's Messages API and to endpoints that speak it.
text: 連線 Anthropic 的 Messages API，以及支援它的端點。

en: Talks to OpenAI-style chat completion endpoints: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral and local servers.
text: 連線 OpenAI 風格的 Chat Completions 端點：OpenAI、OpenRouter、Gemini、Groq、DeepSeek、Mistral 和本機伺服器。

en: Talks to Gemini's own API (Interactions) for chat, transcription and voices: every audio format, Gemini 3's thought signatures carried exactly, its usage with cached and thinking tokens, a voice that streams, Google keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and Google Search on a paid key, its answer shown as Google gave it.
text: 透過 Gemini 自己的 API（Interactions）進行對話、語音轉文字和聲音：支援所有音訊格式，原樣保留 Gemini 3 的思考簽名，用量包含快取和思考 token，聲音可串流播放，對話由 Google 在輪次之間儲存，因此每次只傳送新內容；付費金鑰還可使用 Google 搜尋，答案按 Google 給出的樣子顯示。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords).

en: Phone quality, 8 kHz (about 0.8 MB a minute)
text: 電話音質，8 kHz（每分鐘約 0.8 MB）

en: Full quality (the most data: about 4 MB a minute of speech)
text: 全音質（資料量最大：每分鐘語音約 4 MB）

en: Stream her voice, so she starts sooner (off: each sentence arrives whole first)
text: 串流播放她的聲音，讓她更早開口（關閉：每句完整到達後再說）

en: Talks to Gemini's Live API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.
text: 連線 Gemini 的 Live API：為 Koe 提供在單一串流中雙向進行的語音對話。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Realtime API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.
text: 連線 OpenAI 的 Realtime API：為 Koe 提供在單一串流中雙向進行的語音對話。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Responses API and to servers that speak it, OpenAI keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and the stored responses deleted when annai is told to.
text: 連線 OpenAI 的 Responses API 以及支援它的伺服器。對話由 OpenAI 在輪次之間儲存，因此每次只傳送新內容；annai 收到指示時會刪除已儲存的回覆。

en: Any other server: an OpenAI-compatible one, a router or proxy, or a server you run. Give its address, and annai looks for what it offers, at no cost.
text: 任何其他伺服器：OpenAI 相容的伺服器、路由或代理，或你自己執行的伺服器。填寫它的網址，annai 會免費檢視它提供什麼。

en: A server that never streams sends each answer whole, so annai sees nothing of it until all of it has come: if long answers stop with "No output started in time.", raise the role's "Wait for the first words" in Settings → Models, and Settings → Voice → "Wait for her first words".
text: 從不串流輸出的伺服器會把每個回答整個傳來，所以在全部到達之前 annai 什麼也看不到：如果長回答以「沒有在限定時間內開始輸出。」中止，請在設定 → 模型中調高該角色的「等待第一句」，並調高設定 → 語音 → 「等待她開口」。
note: Note: Quotes annai's own error (沒有在限定時間內開始輸出。) and the two settings' labels (等待第一句, 等待她開口) as annai's rows write them.

en: For servers that speak OpenAI's Responses API. Keeping the conversation on the server, so each turn sends only what is new, is off here until you turn it on: a server that ignores previous_response_id would answer without the conversation. If one refuses requests, try "phase": false, "nowRole": "user" or "encryptedReasoning": false in the tunables. Give a reasoning model its Reasoning levels on its page; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 用於支援 OpenAI Responses API 的伺服器。在伺服器上儲存對話、讓每一輪只傳送新內容的功能，在你開啟之前在這裡是關閉的：忽略 previous_response_id 的伺服器會在沒有對話的情況下回答。如果伺服器拒絕請求，請在可調參數中試試 "phase": false、"nowRole": "user" 或 "encryptedReasoning": false。請在推理模型的頁面上設定它的推理等級；否則它思考時不顯示進度，還可能超出時間限制。

en: Give the address without /v1: Anthropic Messages adds /v1/messages itself.
text: 請填寫不帶 /v1 的網址：Anthropic Messages 會自己加上 /v1/messages。

note: Note: 聲音: the Voice ability, as annai's own kindWords (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen (語音).
Note: 即時語音 as annai's own Live voice (the realtime ability's kind); 語音 here is speech, not the glossary's voice (聲音).

en: For a server that speaks OpenAI's Realtime API over a WebSocket, at this address plus /realtime. Add its models by id. annai gives the key as the browser's subprotocol, as OpenAI's own does.
text: 用於透過 WebSocket 支援 OpenAI Realtime API 的伺服器，網址為此網址加上 /realtime。請按 ID 新增它的模型。annai 會像 OpenAI 自己那樣，把金鑰作為瀏覽器的子協定傳遞。

en: The path is there; Test says whether a model there can listen.
text: 路徑存在；「測試」會告訴你那裡的模型能否辨識語音。
note: Note: "listen" is a transcription model's job: 識別語音 reads better than a bare 聽.

en: The path is there; Test says whether a model there can speak.
text: 路徑存在；「測試」會告訴你那裡的模型能否說話。

en: Its model list names no voice, so it's added switched off.
text: 它的模型清單中沒有聲音模型，所以新增時處於關閉狀態。

en: Its model list names no transcription model, so it's added switched off.
text: 它的模型清單中沒有語音轉文字模型，所以新增時處於關閉狀態。

en: Blocked: it doesn't allow web apps (no CORS).
text: 被阻止：它不允許網頁應用程式呼叫（沒有 CORS）。

en: annai couldn't reach {0}. Check the address and your connection.
text: annai 無法連線 {0}。請檢查網址和網路連線。

en: {0} doesn't allow web apps like annai to call it (no CORS headers), so annai can't use it from a browser. If it has a setting for the addresses allowed to call it (CORS), add annai's.
text: {0} 不允許像 annai 這樣的網頁應用程式呼叫它（沒有 CORS 標頭），所以 annai 無法在瀏覽器中使用它。如果它有允許呼叫的網址的設定（CORS），請加入 annai 的網址。

en: annai found nothing at {0} that it can use. Below is why.
text: annai 在 {0} 上沒有找到能用的東西。原因見下文。

note: Note: 聲音: the Voice ability, as annai's own row with the same key, not the Settings → Voice screen (語音).

text: 網址已更改：請重新檢視。
金鑰已更改：請重新檢視。

en: Adding it, with what it needs…
text: 正在新增它及其所需的內容…

en: annai only asked for the model list and sent an empty request to each known path. Nothing here costs money; Test sends real requests.
text: annai 只請求了模型清單，並向每個已知路徑傳送了空請求。這裡不花錢；「測試」會傳送真實請求。

en: Looking: the model list, then an empty request to each known path…
text: 正在檢視：先是模型清單，然後向每個已知路徑傳送空請求…

en: Give its address, and its key if it needs one. annai looks for what it offers, at no cost, then adds it with what it found.
text: 請填寫它的網址，如果需要的話再填寫金鑰。annai 會免費檢視它提供什麼，然後連同找到的內容一起新增。

en: Give the server's address first, with https:// in front.
text: 請先填寫伺服器網址，前面加上 https://。

en: Give the address alone, without a name and password, "?…" or "#…": a key goes in its own field.
text: 請只填寫網址，不要帶使用者名稱和密碼、「?…」或「#…」：金鑰填在它自己的欄位中。
note: Note: "a name and password" is the user name in an address (https://user:pass@…), so 使用者名稱.

en: The key has a character no key has, such as a space or a line break: paste it again.
text: 金鑰中含有金鑰不會有的字元，例如空格或換行：請重新貼上。
它沒有在 # 秒內回應。
note: plural; # = WAIT_MS / 1000; English: "It didn't answer within # second." (one), "It didn't answer within # seconds." (other)

en: It doesn't allow web apps like annai to call it (no CORS).
text: 它不允許像 annai 這樣的網頁應用程式呼叫它（沒有 CORS）。

en: It answered with a redirect, which annai doesn't follow.
text: 它用重新導向作了回應，annai 不會跟隨。

en: A web page answered, not an API.
text: 回應的是網頁，而不是 API。

en: It answers this way at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it.
text: 它對任何網址（即使是不可能存在的網址）都這樣回應，所以 annai 無法據此判斷。

en: It answered, but not with a list of models.
text: 它有回應，但不是模型清單。

en: The server says it doesn't do this.
text: 伺服器表示它不支援這個。

en: It asks for a key before it says what it has: give the key, then look again.
text: 它在說明提供什麼之前要求金鑰：請填寫金鑰後重新檢視。

en: It refuses the key at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it. Check the key, then look again.
text: 它在任何網址（即使是不可能存在的網址）都拒絕這個金鑰，所以 annai 無法據此判斷。請檢查金鑰後重新檢視。

en: It answers HTTP {0} at any address, even one that can't exist, so annai can't tell from it.
text: 它對任何網址（即使是不可能存在的網址）都回應 HTTP {0}，所以 annai 無法據此判斷。

en: It asks for a key, and annai couldn't check whether it asks at every address: give the key, then look again.
text: 它要求金鑰，annai 無法確認它是否在每個網址都要求：請填寫金鑰後重新檢視。

en: It refused the key, and annai couldn't check how it answers an address that can't exist. Check the key, then look again.
text: 它拒絕了這個金鑰，annai 也無法確認它如何回應不可能存在的網址。請檢查金鑰後重新檢視。

en: It didn't take the key: check it.
text: 它不接受這個金鑰：請檢查。

en: It is busy (too many requests): look again in a minute.
text: 它正忙（請求太多）：請一分鐘後重新檢視。

en: It had a problem of its own (HTTP {0}): look again later.
text: 它自身出了問題（HTTP {0}）：請稍後重新檢視。

en: It answered HTTP {0}, which says neither yes nor no.
text: 它回應了 HTTP {0}，這既不能說明有，也不能說明沒有。

en: Claude models through Anthropic's Messages API, with web search, and a cache that can last an hour.
text: 透過 Anthropic 的 Messages API 使用 Claude 模型，支援網頁搜尋，快取最長可保留一小時。

en: DeepSeek's models, with their reasoning shown as they think.
text: DeepSeek 的模型，思考時會顯示推理過程。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。

en: Gemini models through Google's own API, with Google Search on a paid key, its transcription and voices, and Gemini Live for a voice conversation.
text: 透過 Google 自己的 API 使用 Gemini 模型，付費金鑰可使用 Google 搜尋，另有 Google 的語音轉文字和聲音，以及用於語音對話的 Gemini Live。

en: Uses Gemini's own API. AI Studio shows each key's tier: a free key's requests are limited per minute and per day. Add more models with Fetch model list.
text: 使用 Gemini 自己的 API。AI Studio 會顯示每個金鑰的層級：免費金鑰的請求有每分鐘和每天的次數限制。可用「取得模型清單」新增更多模型。

en: Since version 2.0 this goes through Gemini's own API, not its OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A model without a context window here was added before then, or by id: if it doesn't answer, remove it and add it again with Fetch model list.
text: 從 2.0 版起，這裡走的是 Gemini 自己的 API，而不是它的 OpenAI 相容端點。這裡沒有上下文視窗的模型是在那之前或按 ID 新增的：如果它不回答，請移除後用「取得模型清單」重新新增。
note: Note: remove → 移除, as the model page's button "Remove model" (移除模型).

en: Turns what you say into text, for a model that doesn't take audio. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is Google's own; Flash Lite writes it down when asked, for less. Their prices are estimates from Google's rates for audio, about 25 tokens a second.
text: 把你說的話轉成文字，供不接受音訊的模型使用。Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 是 Google 自己的；Flash Lite 在被要求時也能轉錄，價格更低。價格是根據 Google 的音訊費率（每秒約 25 個 token）估算的。

en: Shiori's voice, a sentence at a time, each sentence one request. It streams: she starts about half a second after a sentence is written, and on a weak connection she waits until it won't stutter. Switch streaming off to have each sentence arrive whole, as other voices do. On the free tier Google allows each of these voices only 10 requests a day and 3 a minute: far fewer than a day of replies, so after the first few sentences the next voice in the list speaks. Prices are estimates per character from Google's rate for audio, 25 tokens a second. Her voice is Sulafat unless the Tunables here name another (it is the warm one of Google's 30; Achird is friendly, Vindemiatrix gentle, Kore firm), and the Style goes as Google's own speech_metadata style.
text: Shiori 的聲音，一次一句，每句一次請求。它是串流的：一句寫出後約半秒她就開始說話；連線較弱時，她會等到不會卡頓再說。關閉串流播放後，每句會像其他聲音一樣完整到達後再說。使用免費額度時，Google 對這些聲音每個每天只允許 10 次請求、每分鐘 3 次：遠遠不夠一天的回覆，所以說完前幾句後會由清單中的下一個聲音來說。價格是根據 Google 的音訊費率（每秒 25 個 token）按字元估算的。除非這裡的可調參數指定了別的聲音，她的聲音是 Sulafat（Google 30 種聲音中溫暖的那個；Achird 友善，Vindemiatrix 溫柔，Kore 堅定），風格會作為 Google 自己的 speech_metadata 中的 style 傳送。
note: Note: free tier → 免費額度, as the zh review settled ("This key is on the free tier" → 此金鑰為免費額度).

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (Gemini Live). While a session is open, what you say goes to Google as audio. Free on AI Studio's free tier. Koe speaks with Sulafat here too (from the Gemini Live protocol 0.2: Settings → Updates brings it), the voice of Classic, so she sounds the same in both.
text: 為 Koe 提供在單一串流中雙向語音的對話（Gemini Live）。會話開啟期間，你說的話會以音訊形式傳送給 Google。在 AI Studio 的免費額度內免費。Koe 在這裡也用 Sulafat 說話，也就是 Koe · 經典 的聲音（從 Gemini Live 協定 0.2 起，可在設定 → 更新中取得），所以她在兩種模式下聽起來一樣。
note: Note: free tier → 免費額度; "Classic" is the mode Koe · Classic (glossary Koe · 經典).

en: Fast open models, and fast Whisper transcription.
text: 快速的開放模型，以及快速的 Whisper 語音轉文字。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。

en: Fast Whisper. Groq bills each request as at least 10 seconds.
text: 快速的 Whisper。Groq 對每次請求至少按 10 秒計費。

en: Models on a llama.cpp server you run (llama-server), or one built on it such as Unsloth Studio or KoboldCpp. Their thinking is switched off for quick decisions.
text: 你自己執行的 llama.cpp 伺服器（llama-server）上的模型，或基於它的伺服器（如 Unsloth Studio、KoboldCpp）上的模型。快速判斷時會關閉思考。

en: llama-server listens on port 9931 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty. Unsloth Studio serves at its own address (port 8888 unless changed), with a key (sk-unsloth-…) from its Settings → API.
text: 除非用 --port 另行指定，llama-server 監聽 9931 埠；用 --api-key 給它設金鑰，或者把金鑰留空。Unsloth Studio 在自己的網址上提供服務（除非改過，埠為 8888），金鑰（sk-unsloth-…）在它的 Settings → API 中取得。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For the model the server has loaded, it reads the context each conversation gets and whether the model reads images (llama-server's /props). For another, set its context window on its page (llama-server's -c, or the context length set in Unsloth Studio), and tick Takes photos if it reads images. llama-server started with --tools or --agent lets in only pages on its own computer: add annai's address with --cors-origins https://annai.guide.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。對於伺服器已載入的模型，會讀取每段對話可用的上下文長度，以及模型能否讀圖（llama-server 的 /props）。其他模型請在其頁面上設定上下文視窗（llama-server 的 -c，或在 Unsloth Studio 中設定的上下文長度）；如果它能讀圖，請勾選「接受照片」。用 --tools 或 --agent 啟動的 llama-server 只允許同一台電腦上的頁面存取：請用 --cors-origins https://annai.guide 新增 annai 的網址。
LM Studio 伺服器上的模型。

en: In LM Studio's server settings, turn on Enable CORS so annai's page may call it, and Serve on Local Network if it's reached from another computer. It listens on port 1234 unless changed. If you turned on its authentication, give its API token as the key.
text: 在 LM Studio 的伺服器設定中開啟 Enable CORS，讓 annai 的頁面能呼叫它；如果要從另一台電腦存取，還要開啟 Serve on Local Network。除非改過，它監聽 1234 埠。如果你開啟了它的身分驗證，請把它的 API 權杖填為金鑰。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For a model loaded in LM Studio, it reads the context it was loaded with, and whether it reads images and was trained for tool calls; for one not loaded, set its context window on its page. LM Studio doesn't document how thinking is switched: set a model's Reasoning levels on its page if it thinks.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。對於在 LM Studio 中已載入的模型，會讀取它載入時的上下文長度，以及它能否讀圖、是否為工具呼叫訓練過；未載入的模型請在其頁面上設定上下文視窗。LM Studio 沒有說明如何開關思考：如果模型會思考，請在其頁面上設定推理等級。

en: Transcription and a voice from a server you run, such as Speaches, whisper.cpp or Kokoro.
text: 由你自己執行的伺服器（如 Speaches、whisper.cpp 或 Kokoro）提供語音轉文字和聲音。

en: Speaches or whisper.cpp, at the provider's address. Add models by id, or with Fetch model list. whisper.cpp's server takes only WAV, MP3 and FLAC unless started with --convert: then set its audioIn to ["mp3", "flac", "wav"].
text: 在供應商的網址上使用 Speaches 或 whisper.cpp。按 ID 或用「取得模型清單」新增模型。除非用 --convert 啟動，whisper.cpp 的伺服器只接受 WAV、MP3 和 FLAC：這種情況下請把它的 audioIn 設為 ["mp3", "flac", "wav"]。

en: Kokoro or Speaches, at its own address. Add a voice model by id, and put one of its voices in the model's Voice (Kokoro's are such as af_heart). They take no Style: it is kept, not sent; remove "styled": false from a model's tunables for a server that does.
text: 在它自己的網址上使用 Kokoro 或 Speaches。按 ID 新增一個聲音模型，並在模型的「聲音」中填入它的一個聲音（Kokoro 的如 af_heart）。它們不接受風格：風格會儲存但不會傳送；如果伺服器接受，請從模型的可調參數中刪除 "styled": false。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。

en: Models on Ollama, with their thinking switched off for quick decisions.
text: Ollama 上的模型，快速判斷時會關閉思考。

en: Ollama lets in only pages on its own computer: start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide so annai's page may call it. It listens on port 11434.
text: Ollama 只允許同一台電腦上的頁面存取：請用 OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide 啟動它，讓 annai 的頁面能呼叫它。它監聽 11434 埠。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. It reads what Ollama says of each: whether it reads images, calls tools and thinks, and its context while it is loaded (as ollama ps shows), else the num_ctx its Modelfile sets. A model that thinks gets low, medium and high; for one that can't, annai only switches thinking off, for quick decisions, as it refuses a named level. Ollama holds only 4K tokens of a conversation unless told (with under 24 GiB of video memory), far less than Shiori needs: start it with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000, and set the context window of a model not loaded when you fetched the list on its page. Ollama can't be made to call a given tool, so a quick decision may go to the main model instead.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。它會讀取 Ollama 對每個模型的說明：能否讀圖、能否呼叫工具、是否會思考，以及載入期間的上下文長度（與 ollama ps 顯示的相同），否則讀取其 Modelfile 設定的 num_ctx。會思考的模型有 low、medium 和 high；不會思考的模型會拒絕指定的等級，所以 annai 只在快速判斷時關閉思考。除非另行指定，Ollama 只保留對話的 4K 個 token（顯示記憶體低於 24 GiB 時），遠少於 Shiori 所需：請用 OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 啟動它；取得清單時未載入的模型，請在其頁面上設定上下文視窗。Ollama 無法被要求呼叫指定的工具，所以快速判斷可能會改由主要模型來做。

en: GPT models through OpenAI's Responses API, with OpenAI's transcription and voices, and its Realtime voice for Koe, on one key.
text: 透過 OpenAI 的 Responses API 使用 GPT 模型，另有 OpenAI 的語音轉文字和聲音，以及供 Koe 使用的 Realtime 語音，全部用一個金鑰。

note: Note: Chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords in src/core/llm/contract.js).

en: The one to use for OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only through Responses. Reasoning summaries may need a verified organization at OpenAI; without one, add "reasoningSummary": false to the tunables. A reasoning model added with Fetch model list needs its Reasoning levels set, as these models have; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 在 OpenAI 上請用這個：GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只透過 Responses 呼叫工具。推理摘要可能需要在 OpenAI 有經過驗證的組織；沒有的話，請在可調參數中加入 "reasoningSummary": false。用「取得模型清單」新增的推理模型需要像這些模型一樣設定推理等級；否則它思考時不顯示進度，還可能超出時間限制。

note: Note: Chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability; Chat Completions is the protocol's name.

en: Prefer Chat (Responses): GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only there. Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 請優先使用「對話（Responses）」：GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只在那裡呼叫工具。用「取得模型清單」新增模型。
note: Note: Quotes the ability's own name, 對話（Responses）.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio.
text: 把你說的話轉成文字，供不接受音訊的模型使用。

en: Shiori's voice. GPT-4o mini TTS is priced by audio; its price here is OpenAI's estimate of $0.015 a minute. It takes a Style (OpenAI's instructions); TTS-1 and TTS-1 HD don't, and say nothing of one. OpenAI is retiring all three on January 6, 2027.
text: Shiori 的聲音。GPT-4o mini TTS 按音訊計費；這裡的價格是 OpenAI 估算的每分鐘 $0.015。它接受風格（OpenAI 的 instructions）；TTS-1 和 TTS-1 HD 不接受，並且會不聲不響地忽略它。OpenAI 將於 2027 年 1 月 6 日停用這三個模型。

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (OpenAI Realtime). While a session is open, what you say goes to OpenAI as telephone audio (G.711, a sixth of the data of full quality; "input": "pcm16" in the tunables sends full quality), and gpt-transcribe writes it down, which OpenAI bills apart (about $0.0045 a minute) and Spend per day doesn't count. annai gives your key to OpenAI straight from the browser, where OpenAI suggests short-lived keys made by a server: if Test says the key was rejected, or the address can't be reached, while chat works with the same key, OpenAI is refusing keys from a browser, and its realtime voice would need a server, which annai doesn't have.
text: 為 Koe 提供在單一串流中雙向語音的對話（OpenAI Realtime）。會話開啟期間，你說的話會以電話音質（G.711，資料量是全音質的六分之一；在可調參數中加入 "input": "pcm16" 則傳送全音質）傳送給 OpenAI，並由 gpt-transcribe 轉錄；這部分由 OpenAI 另行計費（每分鐘約 $0.0045），不計入「每日花費」。annai 直接從瀏覽器把你的金鑰交給 OpenAI，而 OpenAI 建議使用由伺服器產生的短期金鑰：如果同一個金鑰用於對話沒有問題，但「測試」顯示金鑰被拒絕或網址無法連線，表示 OpenAI 拒絕來自瀏覽器的金鑰，此時即時語音需要一台伺服器，而 annai 沒有。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: One key for many models, free ones among them, with transcription and voices too. Sign in with OpenRouter, or give a key.
text: 一個金鑰即可使用許多模型（其中有免費的），還有語音轉文字和聲音。請「使用 OpenRouter 登入」，或填寫金鑰。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter is the quickest way, and it starts you on free models.
text: 「使用 OpenRouter 登入」是最快的方式，並且會先讓你用免費模型。

en: One key for many providers. Free models allow 50 requests a day (1,000 a day after $10 of credits). Its transcription and voices use the same key: none of the transcription models is free, and Fish Audio's free voice uses one of the free requests a day for each sentence it says. The others need credits you buy at OpenRouter.
text: 一個金鑰即可使用許多供應商。免費模型每天允許 50 次請求（儲值 $10 餘額後每天 1,000 次）。它的語音轉文字和聲音使用同一個金鑰：語音轉文字模型都不免費；Fish Audio 的免費聲音每說一句就用掉一次每日免費請求。其餘的都需要你在 OpenRouter 儲值的餘額。
note: Note: Credits are a prepaid balance (餘額), as the zh review settled; "The others" are every speech model but Fish Audio's free voice, so 其餘的, not only the voices.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio. The prices are OpenRouter's lowest; it may send a request to a provider that charges more.
text: 把你說的話轉成文字，供不接受音訊的模型使用。價格是 OpenRouter 上的最低價；它可能會把請求傳給收費更高的供應商。

en: Shiori's voice. Each model has voices of its own, suggested in the model's Voice (Fetch model list brings the ones OpenRouter lists). The voice and style set here are Women KatKat, a voice from Fish Audio's library (friendly, clear, young and bright), and a young, cheerful and lively, yet calm and gentle style: every Fish Audio model starts with them, those described below and any added by id (sent no voice, Fish Audio picks another speaker for each sentence). A model added from the list starts with the first warm voice OpenRouter lists for it. Only Fish Audio, Gemini and OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts take a Style; for the others it is kept, not sent. OpenRouter sends MP3 or PCM only.
text: Shiori 的聲音。每個模型都有自己的聲音，會在模型的「聲音」中給出建議（「取得模型清單」會帶來 OpenRouter 列出的聲音）。這裡設定的聲音和風格是 Fish Audio 聲音庫中的 Women KatKat（友善、清晰、年輕明亮）以及年輕、歡快活潑又平靜溫柔的風格：每個 Fish Audio 模型，無論是下面列出的還是按 ID 新增的，都以它們開始（不傳送聲音時，Fish Audio 會為每句話換一個說話者）。從清單新增的模型以 OpenRouter 為它列出的第一個溫暖的聲音開始。只有 Fish Audio、Gemini 和 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 接受風格；其他模型會儲存風格但不會傳送。OpenRouter 只傳送 MP3 或 PCM。
note: Note: "the model's Voice" is the model page's Voice field, 聲音 (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen.

en: Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to start again.
text: 請點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」重新開始。

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you, then tap Connect.
text: 請貼上 OpenRouter 顯示的程式碼，然後點一下「連線」。

en: annai has no sign-in waiting for this code: it was used already, or began in another browser.
text: annai 沒有在等待這個程式碼的登入：它已被使用過，或是在另一個瀏覽器中開始的。

en: This sign-in didn't start in this browser, so annai ignored it.
text: 這次登入不是在這個瀏覽器中開始的，所以 annai 忽略了它。

en: annai couldn't reach OpenRouter. Check the connection and try again.
text: annai 無法連線 OpenRouter。請檢查網路連線後再試。

en: OpenRouter answered with a redirect, which annai doesn't follow with your sign-in.
text: OpenRouter 用重新導向作了回應，annai 不會帶著你的登入資訊跟隨重新導向。

en: OpenRouter didn't take the code: a code works once, for 10 minutes. Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to get a new one.
text: OpenRouter 不接受這個程式碼：程式碼只能用一次，有效期 10 分鐘。請點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」取得新程式碼。

en: Nothing was sent to OpenRouter yet: try again.
text: 還沒有向 OpenRouter 傳送任何內容：請再試一次。

en: annai keeps the new key for OpenRouter's chat, transcription and voices.
text: annai 會把新金鑰用於 OpenRouter 的對話、語音轉文字和聲音。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: Shiori thinks with free models to start, so trying annai costs nothing. annai also added OpenRouter's transcription and voices, behind the phone's own dictation and the browser voice. Its free voice comes first: each sentence it says uses one of the free requests a day the chat models use too. The others cost a little, from credits you buy at OpenRouter. To use them first, move them up under Roles.
text: Shiori 一開始用免費模型思考，所以試用 annai 不花錢。annai 還新增了 OpenRouter 的語音轉文字和聲音，排在手機自帶的語音輸入和瀏覽器聲音之後。其中免費聲音排在前面：它每說一句，就用掉一次對話模型也在用的每日免費請求。其他聲音要花一點錢，從你在 OpenRouter 儲值的餘額中扣除。要優先使用它們，請在「角色」中把它們上移。
note: Note: Credits → 餘額 (a prepaid balance), as the zh review settled; the phone's dictation → 手機語音輸入, as annai's own rows.

en: OpenRouter opens in Safari. Sign in there; it then shows a code, which works for 10 minutes. Copy it, come back to annai, and paste it here.
text: OpenRouter 會在 Safari 中開啟。在那裡登入後會顯示一個有效期 10 分鐘的程式碼。複製它，回到 annai，貼到這裡。

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you
text: 貼上 OpenRouter 顯示的程式碼

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap it again.
text: annai 已準備了新的登入：請再點一下。

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap Sign in with OpenRouter again.
text: annai 已準備了新的登入：請再點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」。

en: Sign in again for a new key, in place of the one saved.
text: 重新登入以取得新金鑰，替換已儲存的那個。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter for a key, or give one below.
text: 請「使用 OpenRouter 登入」取得金鑰，或在下方填寫金鑰。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter to get one key for many models. annai starts you on free models (50 requests a day), so trying it costs nothing. It also adds OpenRouter's transcription and voices, a free one among them; the phone's own dictation and voice stay first.
text: 「使用 OpenRouter 登入」即可用一個金鑰使用許多模型。annai 會先讓你用免費模型（每天 50 次請求），所以試用不花錢。它還會新增 OpenRouter 的語音轉文字和聲音（其中有一個免費的）；手機自帶的語音輸入和聲音仍排在前面。
note: Note: The phone's dictation → 語音輸入, as annai's own rows (Phone dictation → 手機語音輸入).
Note: annai's own rows call it 指令碼模型 (Simulate: "A scripted model (Settings → Models) makes it free").

en: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.
text: 按腳本回覆的模型，供測試和外掛程式作者使用。它從不使用網路。

en: Models on an SGLang server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template.
text: 你自己執行的 SGLang 伺服器上的模型，思考透過聊天範本開關。

en: SGLang listens on port 30000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: 除非用 --port 另行指定，SGLang 監聽 30000 埠；用 --api-key 給它設金鑰，或者把金鑰留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型：每個模型都會帶上伺服器保有的上下文長度。工具呼叫需要 --tool-call-parser <name>，會思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；沒有它們，Shiori 無法使用工具，她的思考也會混進她的話裡。

en: Models on a vLLM server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template, and Whisper models for transcription.
text: 你自己執行的 vLLM 伺服器上的模型，思考透過聊天範本開關，另有用於語音轉文字的 Whisper 模型。

en: vLLM listens on port 8000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: 除非用 --port 另行指定，vLLM 監聽 8000 埠；用 --api-key 給它設金鑰，或者把金鑰留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型：每個模型都會帶上伺服器保有的上下文長度。工具呼叫需要 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>，會思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；沒有它們，Shiori 無法使用工具，她的思考也會混進她的話裡。

en: For a Whisper model on a vLLM server of its own: give that server's address as this ability's own, and add the model by id.
text: 用於在單獨的 vLLM 伺服器上執行的 Whisper 模型：把那台伺服器的網址填為此功能自己的網址，再按 ID 新增模型。

note: Note: As annai's own Experimental row names it (遠端記錄（開發者）); Trace is the glossary's 記錄.

en: For developers: sends annai's trace, as the Trace screen shows it, to a server you run, while you watch. It sends nothing until you give it a server and a token and turn Send on. Never keys.
text: 開發人員用：在你檢視時，把 annai 的記錄按「記錄」頁面顯示的樣子傳送到你自己執行的伺服器。在你填寫伺服器和權杖並開啟「傳送」之前，它什麼也不傳送。從不傳送金鑰。

en: Where annai sends its trace: a server you run, such as annai's scripts/trace-sink.mjs. https://…, or http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.
text: annai 傳送記錄的去處：你自己執行的伺服器，例如 annai 的 scripts/trace-sink.mjs。用 https://…，http:// 只能用於 localhost 或 127.0.0.1。

en: The server's token. annai sends it as Authorization: Bearer, and keeps it with your keys, never in a file.
text: 伺服器的權杖。annai 以 Authorization: Bearer 傳送它，並和你的金鑰一起儲存，從不放進檔案。

en: Also send the location points annai records while GPS is on, about one a second on a drive. Off, other entries can still name a place, as the Trace shows them: a weather request's address, a tool's input.
text: 同時傳送 GPS 開啟時 annai 記錄的位置點（駕駛時約每秒一個）。關閉時，其他條目仍可能包含地點，正如「記錄」中顯示的：天氣請求的地址、工具的輸入等。

en: On, what the Trace records from now on goes to the server within a few seconds: what you write, what Shiori says, her tools, requests and errors. Keys are blanked, and stored content (photos, long texts) stays here. Off stops it at once.
text: 開啟後，從現在起「記錄」所記下的內容會在幾秒內傳送到伺服器：你寫的、Shiori 說的、她的工具、請求和錯誤。金鑰會被遮蓋，已儲存的內容（照片、長文字）留在這裡。關閉會立即停止。

en: Sent with each batch, so the server can tell this device from another. annai makes one at the first send; you may give it a name of your own.
text: 隨每批一起傳送，讓伺服器能把本裝置與其他裝置區分開。annai 會在第一次傳送時產生一個；你也可以自己命名。

en: It needs the address of your server.
Its server address must start with https:// (http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1).
text: 伺服器網址必須以 https:// 開頭（http:// 只能用於 localhost 或 127.0.0.1）。

en: Its server address has a name or password in it, which a request can't carry. Take it out, and give the server's token as the Token.
text: 伺服器網址中含有使用者名稱或密碼，請求無法攜帶它們。請把它們去掉，並把伺服器的權杖填到「權杖」中。
note: Note: "a name or password" in an address is its user name (https://user:pass@…), so 使用者名稱.

en: Change it in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers).
text: 請在設定 → 外掛程式 → 遠端記錄（開發人員）中更改。
note: Note: Settings paths sit in the sentence without spaces, as annai's rows write them.

en: annai couldn't get the batch ready.
text: annai 無法準備好這一批。
正在傳送記錄：# 筆等待中。
note: plural; # = waiting; English: "Sending trace: # waiting." (one), "Sending trace: # waiting." (other)

en: It needs the server's token. Add it in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers).
text: 需要伺服器的權杖。請在設定 → 外掛程式 → 遠端記錄（開發人員）中新增。

en: Its token has characters a request can't carry: letters, digits and punctuation only, no spaces.
text: 權杖中含有請求無法攜帶的字元：只能用字母、數字和標點，不能有空格。

en: The trace server refuses what annai sends
text: 記錄伺服器拒絕了 annai 傳送的內容

en: {0} answered {1} {2} times in a row: the token may be wrong.
text: {0} 連續 {2} 次傳回了 {1}：權杖可能不對。

en: annai keeps trying about once a minute, and keeps the newest {0} entries until they go. Check the server address and the token in Settings → Plugins → Remote trace (for developers), or turn Send off there.
text: annai 會繼續大約每分鐘嘗試一次，並保留最新的 {0} 筆，直到送出為止。請在設定 → 外掛程式 → 遠端記錄（開發人員）中檢查伺服器網址和權杖，或在那裡關閉「傳送」。

note: Note: annai's own rows call it 指令碼模型 (Simulate).

en: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.
text: 按腳本回覆的模型，供測試和外掛程式作者使用。它從不使用網路。

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜尋; annai's credits rows name Tavily's and Serper's the same way.

en: Searches through a SearXNG instance you run. No key, no limits but your own. The instance must allow JSON and web apps.
text: 透過你自己執行的 SearXNG 執行個體搜尋。無需金鑰，沒有限制（除了你自己設的）。執行個體必須允許 JSON 和網頁應用程式。

en: Like https://search.example.com. In the instance's settings.yml, put json under search: formats:, and have its web server send Access-Control-Allow-Origin for annai's address. Plain http works only for localhost.
text: 例如 https://search.example.com。在執行個體的 settings.yml 中，把 json 加到 search: formats: 下，並讓它的網頁伺服器為 annai 的網址傳送 Access-Control-Allow-Origin。不加密的 http 只能用於 localhost。
note: Note: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is a header's name, kept as written; not the phone's Allow.

en: needs the address of your instance (Settings → Plugins → SearXNG Search)
text: 需要你的執行個體網址（設定 → 外掛程式 → SearXNG 搜尋）

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜尋, as the credits row now names it.

en: Google's results through Serper, with its answer box. 2,500 free searches on sign-up, no card.
text: 透過 Serper 取得 Google 的搜尋結果，附帶它的答案框。註冊即送 2,500 次免費搜尋，無需信用卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 銀行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片).

en: 2,500 free searches on sign-up, no card.
text: 註冊即送 2,500 次免費搜尋，無需信用卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 銀行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片).

en: needs a key (Settings → Plugins → Serper Search)
text: 需要金鑰（設定 → 外掛程式 → Serper 搜尋）

note: Note: annai translates its own plugins' descriptive word (decision 10): Search → 搜尋, as the credits row now names it.

en: Web search made for AI agents, with a snippet of each page. 1,000 free credits a month, no card.
text: 為 AI 代理打造的網頁搜尋，附帶每個頁面的摘要。每月 1,000 個免費額度，無需信用卡。
note: Note: "no card" is a payment card: 銀行卡, not the glossary's card (卡片). Tavily's credits are a monthly allowance, not a prepaid balance, so 額度, not 餘額.

text: MCP 伺服器為 Shiori 提供它自己的工具。這些工具出現在設定 → 工具中，每個都可以關閉，送往伺服器的每個請求都在記錄中。伺服器回答的內容是否可信由你判斷，就像你帶進來的其他東西一樣。
還沒有 MCP 伺服器。

text: 以後要更改伺服器的權杖或請求標頭，請先移除再重新新增。

text: 上下文視窗是整數個 token；不知道時請留空。

text: 最大輸出是整數個 token；不知道時請留空。

text: 這個聲音不支援風格：會儲存，但不傳送。

en: How she should sound, in a few words, such as calm, warm and friendly.
text: 她該怎樣說話，用幾個詞描述，比如平靜、溫暖、友善。

en: A transcription model: it turns what you say into text.
text: 語音轉文字模型：把你說的話變成文字。

en: A live voice: it hears and speaks in one stream, as Koe.
text: 即時語音：作為 Koe，在同一個串流中邊聽邊說。
note: Note: A live voice is the glossary's Live voice (即時語音), not a voice she speaks with (聲音).

Sent with every request. Emptied, the model's default (grey) is used; to send none, put "voice": null in Extra request fields.
text: 隨每個請求傳送。清空後使用模型的預設值（灰色）；如果什麼都不想傳送，請在額外請求欄位中寫 "voice": null。
note: Note: "voice": null is a JSON field, typed as written.

Note: The JSON keys stay as typed.

text: Koe · 即時：在同一個串流中聽你說並說話

text: Koe · 經典：對話模型，配合語音辨識和朗讀

note: Note: "voice is on" is the glossary's Voice on mode (語音開啟) and the voice chip is 語音按鈕, both from the Voice screen's 語音, not a voice she speaks with (聲音).

en: Koe uses it when Classic is chosen, while voice is off, and when Realtime can't answer: Speech in hears you, and Speech out speaks.

note: Note: "voice is off" is the glossary's Voice off mode (語音關閉), not a voice she speaks with (聲音).

en: Where Shiori thinks: the providers annai calls, their models, which models each role tries, in order, and what her requests may cost.
text: Shiori 思考的地方：annai 呼叫的供應商、它們的模型、每個角色依次嘗試的模型，以及她的請求可能花費多少。
note: Note: "may cost" is an estimate (可能), not what she is allowed to spend.

en: What Shiori's model calls may cost in a day, in all your trips. Once it is spent, her turn ends with a card, and she goes on the next day. Empty: no limit.
text: Shiori 的模型呼叫在所有旅行中一天可花的金額。用完後，她的這一輪會以一張卡片結束，第二天繼續。留空：不限。

en: A day costs at least $0.01; leave it empty for no limit.
text: 每日至少 0.01 美元；留空表示不限。

en: Providers keep the start of the conversation for a while, so her next request costs less. An hour costs more to write than five minutes, and pays off when you talk less often than every few minutes. A model that keeps it only five minutes is asked for five.
text: 供應商會把對話的開頭保留一段時間，讓她的下一個請求更便宜。保留一小時的寫入費用比五分鐘高，如果你說話的間隔比幾分鐘長，就划算。只保留五分鐘的模型會按五分鐘請求。

text: 總結比例請設在 50% 到 90% 之間。

text: 最大請求為 1 到 64 MiB。

text: 語音清單也從上往下嘗試：使用對聽你說話的模型可用的第一項，以及第一個回應的聲音。

en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. Exa also reads a page that no other reader can, which sends it that page's address. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches. Behind them, a last resort that is always on asks Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) the same words; only Search via: Off stops it.
text: 免費搜尋會把你的搜尋傳送給 Exa、Parallel 或 Firecrawl：只傳送搜尋的詞，不傳送你的檔案或位置。Exa 還會讀取其他方式讀不了的網頁，因此也會收到該網址。它們都是可能變化或停止的免費額度，而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜尋內容訓練模型，所以請不要在搜尋中寫名字和地址。在它們之後，還有一個始終開啟的最後手段，會用同樣的詞詢問 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）；只有「搜尋方式：關閉」能停止它。

en: Only the words she searches for go to the ones you leave ticked, and Exa also gets the addresses of pages it reads for her: not your files or your location. They're free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use searches to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of them. Behind them, Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) are always asked as a last resort; only Settings → Tools → Search via: Off stops that. You can change all this there.

text: 12 秒內沒聽到聲音。請確認麥克風已開啟，然後再試一次。

en: It heard speech but wrote nothing down. Try again, a little closer to the phone.
text: 聽到了語音，但什麼也沒寫出來。請離手機近一點，再試一次。

en: Nothing was half-saved. To make room, remove a trip you no longer need (back it up first), or free up space on this device.
text: 沒有任何內容只儲存了一半。要騰出空間，請移除不再需要的旅行（請先備份），或釋放此裝置上的空間。
note: Note: 移除, as the trip's own button, Remove trip (移除旅行).
plural; # = n; {0} = formatCost(result.cost); English: "# token · {0}" (one), "# tokens · {0}" (other)

en: {0} didn't answer: {1}. No other model was asked.
text: {0}沒有回答：{1}。沒有詢問其他模型。

en: A short conversation with this model alone: if it fails, no other model answers. Each reply shows its tokens and cost. Nothing is kept but the Trace.
text: 只和這個模型的簡短對話：失敗時不會有其他模型回答。每則回覆都會顯示 token 數和費用。除了記錄，什麼都不保留。

en: The check took too long. Check the connection, and try again.
text: 檢查用時過長。請檢查網路連線，然後重試。

en: annai's offline service hasn't started yet, so annai itself wasn't checked. Try again in a moment.
text: annai 的離線服務尚未啟動，因此沒有檢查 annai 本身。請稍後重試。

en: annai couldn't check for a new version of itself. Check the connection and try again.
text: annai 無法檢查自身的新版本。請檢查網路連線，然後重試。

en: The download of the new version didn't finish. annai tries again the next time it checks.
text: 新版本沒有下載完成。annai 會在下次檢查時重試。

en: annai restarts once Shiori has finished
text: Shiori 完成後，annai 將重新啟動

en: She is in the middle of something, and an update never lands during her turn. Tap her to stop her now.
text: Shiori 正在處理事情，更新不會在她的回合中進行。點一下她可立即停止。
